newsitem.title: GERMANY: Adidas jumps on World Cup sponsor news.
newsitem.headline: Adidas jumps on World Cup sponsor news.

text.p: Shares in German sports equipment maker Adidas AG raced ahead on Tuesday after the group said it would be an official sponsor of the 1998 soccer World Cup and had global licensing rights for the event.
Adidas shares rose three marks or 2.11 percent to a new year's high of 145 marks in early floor trade. They had risen to an IBIS trading high of 148 earlier in pre-bourse trade.
The rest of the market was weaker, with the DAX index down 6.94 points or 0.26 percent at 2,695.70 in early floor trade.
"The news about the sponsorship deal has been well received," said one trader.
Adidas said the first licensed products related to the event would be launched before Christmas this year in France, where the 1998 World Cup takes place.
This will be the first time ever that a sports equipment manufacturer has sponsored a soccer World Cup, Adidas said.
